name: Spellshield: Astra tags the champion to prevent the next damage
notes: Spellshield: Astra is an ASTRA (advanced element) ACTION card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real ASTRA champion (Arisanna, Astral Zenith), reused from meteor-strike-destroy. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 4-reserve cost is paid, and the ability's own effect (tagging the champion) resolves directly after the last reserve payment with no separate opportunity-window PASS needed. The effect is applied as a PREVENT_CHAMP_ASTRA_GLIMPSE turn-effect tag; only the tag application is covered here, not the actual prevention-plus-Glimpse-X math (which requires a subsequent damage instance to observe and is out of scope).

rulesClauses: The next time damage would be dealt to your champion this turn, prevent that damage. Glimpse X, where X is the amount of damage prevented this way.
